messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `per_tenant_batching` for tenant "bluepool" at 17:30 PT today. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m. Need a deploy owner, someone to run the smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Who can own?

mira: I can own the deploy and monitor until 18:15 PT. I'll be on pager for alerts. What exactly are our smoke criteria?

alex: Thanks. Smoke checklist (short):
1) p50 latency on /v1/infer for bluepool < 150ms
2) error rate < 0.1% (5xx + client-retries)
3) KV cache miss rate delta < +5% vs baseline
4) no surge in OOMs or retries in logs
Also run the quick smoke script `./tools/smoke.sh --tenant bluepool`.

sam: I'll execute the canary commands and hold the rollback command ready. Ping me when you start. Confirming: safe default stays OFF for other tenants?

jia: Correct — the feature will be scoped to a tenant map: `feature.flag.per_tenant_batching = {"bluepool": true}`. Global default remains false. Rollback is a single toggle revert (one CLI call).

devops-bot: deploy-runbook snippet:
1) Create 5% canary: `rctl feature enable per_tenant_batching --tenant bluepool --percent 5`
2) Wait 10m, run smoke: `./tools/smoke.sh --tenant bluepool` and check dashboards: /dashboards/latency-bluepool, /dashboards/errors-bluepool
3) If green, bump to 25%: `rctl feature update-percent per_tenant_batching --tenant bluepool --percent 25`
4) After 15m stable, ramp to 100% or schedule increments.
Rollback quick commands:
```
# rollback: disable for tenant
rctl feature disable per_tenant_batching --tenant bluepool
```
Preflight checks: runbook validated, no DB migrations, autoscaler healthy.

mira: I'll run the smoke script and post a short status in this thread. I'll watch latency and error dashboards and tail logs for KV eviction spikes.

alex: Also add a temporary fallback route in case of memory issues: map bluepool -> `small-lm-v2` variant in routing config. I'll open a tiny PR to add the fallback and tag @sam for quick review.

sam: Got it — will approve PR quickly. Who's on pager in this window?

jia: On-call: @mira until 19:00 PT, then @sam takes over. I've added an alert rule: `metric.batch.latency > 200ms for 5m` -> page on-call.

mira: ack. I'll post a roll-call here when I start the canary. ETA to begin: 17:28 PT.

alex: Timeline for clarity:
- 17:30 PT: start 5% canary
- 17:40 PT: run smoke checks
- 17:45 PT: bump to 25% if green
- 18:00 PT: start final ramp to 100% if stable
If any smoke criteria fail -> immediate rollback + ping #incidents and this thread. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll keep the rollback CLI and logs open. Ready to run disable if needed. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: runbook check complete — all automated checks passed. No pending infra changes. :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks all. Mira, ping when you flip and paste the canary command output. We'll call it done once final ramp finishes or we roll back.
notes: This is a short async coordination thread for a feature-flagged, tenant-scoped rollout. Contains deploy owner assignment, smoke checklist, rollback commands, and on-call handoff details.
